scope: Owned recovery conversion staging, durable protection and bounded abandoned-transaction cleanup

mediaBaseline.note: Media source unchanged; app tests cover the shared original-WAV validation refactor

checks.layout: No markup/style changes; no repeat screenshot review

coverage: Failure after earlier files are staged rolls back the owned transaction
Cancellation during a late write and successful retry without partial editor publication
Project/playback changes after protection prevent publication and abort conversions
Successful conversion import is one Undo transaction; retained paths survive Undo/Redo
Synchronous publication/subscriber errors conservatively retain potentially referenced files
Lost finalization acknowledgement preserves successful editor state
Real exclusive filesystem leases exclude another store instance from live staging
Abandoned pending transactions are collected after lease release
Durable abort releases its registry lease even when deletion fails; a later collector can retry
Collection advances beyond a 256-entry page without accumulating an archive list
Unknown files, malformed receipts, symlinks, foreign owners and unreceipted directories are preserved
Window/exit cleanup retains protected files; original recordings stay outside the conversion root
Converted source provenance and linked/portable reopen remain covered
Window/exit lifecycle closes audio owners before conversion file cleanup
limitations: Retained or uncertain publication is never inferred to be unreferenced
Legacy unreceipted conversions require future reference-aware asset management
Interrupted creation or final cleanup can leave a small unknown transaction directory
Active filesystem calls, cleanup errors or unknown directory contents may delay/prevent deletion
Known symlinks are rejected; app-owned filesystem checks are not a hostile mutation boundary
Live-directory collection is bounded but is not a snapshot; later cycles may be required
N5 physical recording/load/device/iOS qualification remains pending
Candidate not installed/launched or submitted to Apple
